UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Private root identity and authentication profile document for a MISSION AI user (guest or registered), strictly isolated by Firebase UID.

uid.description: Firebase Authentication UID matching the document ID and owner.

accountType.description: Authentication classification derived from Firebase Auth provider state.

isAnonymous.description: True when the user is currently an anonymous guest session.

email.description: Optional email address when linked or signed in with a permanent provider.

emailVerified.description: Whether the linked email address has been verified.

photoURL.description: Optional profile avatar URL from OAuth provider.

onboardingCompleted.description: Tracks whether initial security orientation is completed.

linkedProviders.description: List of linked Firebase Auth provider IDs (e.g., google.com, password, apple.com, microsoft.com).

accountStatus.description: Current lifecycle state of the user account.

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when profile was initialized.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest profile update.

UserPrivateSettings.title: UserPrivateSettings
UserPrivateSettings.description: Isolated private security and session preferences belonging exclusively to a single UID.

dataRetentionNoticeSeen.description: Whether the guest data retention and recovery policy notice was acknowledged.

securityNotifications.description: Whether security event alerts are enabled.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest update.

IsolationProbeRecord.title: IsolationProbeRecord
IsolationProbeRecord.description: Security verification record stored under a user's isolated namespace to verify UID ownership, persistence across guest-to-registered linking, and cross-account isolation.

createdUnderMode.description: Account mode when this record was originally created.

/users/{uid}.description: Private user identity profile strictly owned by {uid}.

/users/{uid}/private/{docId}.description: Private security and session preferences strictly owned by {uid}.

/users/{uid}/isolation_probes/{probeId}.description: Private security verification records strictly owned by {uid} to verify cross-account isolation and UID preservation across account linking.
